claims.quote: around one in twenty shops lying empty
claims.statement: Around one in twenty shops in Edinburgh are lying empty.
In Dundee, the share of empty shops is more likely one in five.

claims.quote: around one in six young people here are not in education, employment or training
claims.statement: Around one in six young people in Scotland are not in education, employment or training.

claims.quote: A man in East Renfrewshire can live, as I understand, on average seven years longer than a man in Glasgow
claims.statement: A man in East Renfrewshire can on average live seven years longer than a man in Glasgow.

claims.quote: a defence sector that already supports 12,000 jobs here in Scotland
claims.statement: The defence sector already supports 12,000 jobs in Scotland.

claims.quote: putting a billion pounds into research and innovation across the UK in the coming years
claims.statement: The UK government will put a billion pounds into research and innovation across the UK in the coming years.

claims.quote: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is itself one of the most centralised nations in Europe
claims.statement: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is one of the most centralised nations in Europe.

claims.quote: I never will accept that some are just written off
claims.statement: The Prime Minister will not accept that some young people are written off.

claims.quote: the National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales
claims.statement: The National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales in a couple of weeks.
The Prime Minister offers Scotland devolution of DWP employment support.

claims.quote: There is a risk that some of the towns and the cities become underpowered
claims.statement: There is a risk that some Scottish towns and cities become underpowered.

facts.quote: I left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester
facts.statement: The Prime Minister left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester.

facts.quote: In August 2023, with the help of the ground-breaking Scottish Violence Reduction Unit, I visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse
facts.statement: In August 2023 the Prime Minister visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse with the Greater Manchester Violence Reduction Unit.

facts.quote: I was the MP there for sixteen years from the early 2000s
facts.statement: The Prime Minister was MP for Leigh for sixteen years from the early 2000s.

facts.quote: When I walked into Downing Street in July
facts.statement: The Prime Minister entered Downing Street in July.

facts.quote: I was in Scotland for the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in the summer
facts.statement: The Prime Minister attended the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in the summer.

facts.quote: I was here between Christmas and New Year last year for Hibs-Hearts
facts.statement: The Prime Minister was in Scotland between Christmas and New Year 2025 for the Hibs-Hearts match.

facts.quote: I used it to pioneer what we called the Live Well model in Greater Manchester
facts.statement: The Prime Minister used lessons from Easterhouse to pioneer the Live Well model in Greater Manchester.

facts.quote: I put buses back under public control
facts.statement: The Prime Minister put buses in Greater Manchester back under public control when he was Mayor.

facts.quote: the Scottish government has this week agreed to match the UK government
facts.statement: The Scottish government agreed this week to match the UK government's £10 million for two defence technical excellence colleges.

facts.quote: Douglas informed me of that news today
facts.statement: Douglas informed the Prime Minister of the defence colleges news on 16 October 2026.
